exhibitions.title: Purchasing across branches
exhibitions.summary: Let branches request supplies, track decisions, and reconcile orders in one place.
exhibitions.visualAlt: Sculpted emerald laminar strata over dark basalt representing layered enterprise records
architectureNotes: Keep each branch’s records separate while giving finance the access it needs for reconciliation.
Allow staff to request purchases and require a separate approval before funds can be released.
Export matching records to the accounting system without re-entering the purchase.

rows.name: Request supplies
rows.detail: A branch employee selects items and submits a purchase request.

rows.name: Review spending
rows.detail: An approver checks the request against the budget and leaves a reason for the decision.

rows.name: Send the order
rows.detail: Purchasing issues the order and the receiving branch records what arrives.

views.heading: Trace a purchase back to its records

rows.name: Match the receipt
rows.detail: Finance checks the delivered quantities against the order and supplier invoice.

rows.name: Resolve a difference
rows.detail: A short delivery stays open for review before payment is released.

rows.name: Close the transaction
rows.detail: The linked records stay available after the accounting period closes.

exhibitions.title: Public records case registry
exhibitions.summary: Give residents a way to submit documents and give reviewers one record of what was received, who reviewed it, and why a decision was made.
exhibitions.visualAlt: Concentric obsidian and emerald glass strata representing structured institutional records
architectureNotes: Separate the public submission form from internal case review and give each role the access it needs.
Record the reviewer, time, and reason each time a case advances.
Verify that records can be restored from backup and protect sensitive files from unnecessary access.

rows.name: Receive a permit renewal
rows.detail: Intake staff confirm the documents are complete and send the case to a reviewer.

rows.name: Review an annual filing
rows.detail: A reviewer checks the filing against the archive and records the outcome.

rows.name: Escalate a transfer request
rows.detail: A designated second reviewer can sign off when the rules require it.

views.heading: Control access to the case history

rows.name: Verify the file
rows.detail: Compare the stored fingerprint with the original submission when integrity is questioned.

rows.name: Limit sensitive data
rows.detail: Show only the fields each reviewer needs.

rows.name: Restore a copy
rows.detail: Test a restore away from the live records before relying on the backup.

exhibitions.title: Approvals across teams
exhibitions.summary: Route routine requests to the right person and give exceptional requests a named reviewer.
exhibitions.visualAlt: Flowing blown-emerald optical wave conduits representing automated workflow paths
architectureNotes: Record every step so staff can see where a request is and why it moved.
Give requests outside the normal rules a clear path to human judgment.
Retry interrupted transfers without creating a second approval or order.

views.heading: Move a request to the right person

rows.name: Check required information
rows.detail: Ask for the missing cost center before the request moves forward.

rows.name: Find the approver
rows.detail: Route requests by department and spending limits.

rows.name: Hand off an exception
rows.detail: Give requests outside policy to a named reviewer with the original details attached.

rows.name: Hold an outgoing update
rows.detail: Store the update while the receiving system is unavailable.

rows.name: Retry safely
rows.detail: When the connection returns, check whether the update has already arrived.

rows.name: Tell the operator
rows.detail: Explain which request needs attention and why.

exhibitions.title: Field dispatch and equipment
exhibitions.summary: Help dispatchers schedule crews and let supervisors record which equipment left the depot and when it came back.
exhibitions.visualAlt: Refractive emerald optical prism casting calibrated light beams over dark slate
architectureNotes: Give dispatchers and field staff interfaces suited to what each team has to do.
Keep a history of equipment handovers, with the responsible person and condition recorded each time.
Allow field notes to wait locally for a connection and make any unresolved synchronization visible.

views.heading: Prepare a crew for the day

rows.name: Assign the job
rows.detail: Confirm the crew and equipment before releasing the schedule.

rows.name: Check out the equipment
rows.detail: Record its condition and which supervisor takes responsibility.

rows.name: Reconcile the return
rows.detail: Record the return condition and note any damage before closing the assignment.

views.heading: Work across depot and field systems

rows.name: Check stock availability
rows.detail: Read the current equipment list from the depot records.

rows.name: Capture notes on location
rows.detail: Keep field updates locally when a connection is unavailable.

rows.name: Export the daily summary
rows.detail: Prepare a report from the same records the dispatcher uses.
